## 📱 AI Social Post Generator

**What this workflow does:**
Takes a topic, URL, or blog post content and generates optimized social posts for LinkedIn, Twitter/X, and Instagram simultaneously. Uses Claude to match each platform's tone and format.

**Setup steps:**
1. Trigger via webhook POST or use the Manual Trigger for testing
2. Add Claude API credentials
3. Optional: Add LinkedIn/Twitter API credentials to auto-post
4. Set your brand voice in the `Brand Config` node

**Payload format:**
```json
{
  "topic": "How AI automation saves 10 hours/week for small teams",
  "url": "https://yourblog.com/post-url",
  "content": "Optional: paste article content directly",
  "tone": "professional|casual|technical|inspirational",
  "include_hashtags": true,
  "include_emoji": true
}
```

assignments.name: brand_voice
assignments.value: Innovative, approachable, technically credible. We make AI automation accessible to every team.

assignments.name: linkedin_author
assignments.value: Your Name — Founder at FlowMind Labs
